spans.s:
भिरिण्टिका भिरिण्टिका, f. a species of plant,
= श्वेत-गुञ्जा; (also read भृण्टिका.)

भीरक, अस्, m. a various reading for भीरुक, a
kind of sugar-cane.

भीरु, उस्, उस्, or ऊस्, उ, fearful, timid, cowardly,
(opposed to शूर); fearing, afraid of (with abl.,
e. g. मरणाद् भीरुः, afraid of death; or at the
end of a comp., e. g. प्रतिज्ञा-भङ्ग-भीरु, afraid
of breaking a promise); (उस्), m. a jackal [cf. फेरु];
a tiger; a kind of sugar-cane; (उस्, ऊस्), f. a timid
woman; a shadow; a goat; a centipede; Solanum
Jacquini or a sort of prickly nightshade; the plant
Asparagus Racemosus, (in some of these last senses
said to be also m.); (उ), n. silver.
—भीरु-चेतस्,
आस्, m. ‘timid-hearted,’ a deer; [cf. भीरु-हृदय.]
—भीरु-जन, अस्, m. one whose servants are
[]
cowards.
—भीरु-ता, f. or भीरु-त्व, अम्, n. fear-
fulness, timidity, cautiousness, cowardice; natural
cowardice (as of a tiger, cf. भीरु, col. 1).
—भीरु-
पत्त्री, f. Asparagus Racemosus.
—भीरु-मय,
अस्, ई, अम्, fearful, terrible, frightful.
—भीरु-योध,
अस्, आ, अम्, having cowardly soldiers, possessing a
cowardly garrison.
—भीरु-रन्ध्र, अस्, m. ‘having
a fearful chasm,’ an oven, a furnace.
—भीरु-सत्त्व,
अस्, आ, अम्, having a timid nature, fearful, timid.
—भीरु-हृदय, अस्, आ, अम्, timid-hearted, fearful,
timid; (अस्), m. a deer; [cf. भीरु-चेतस्.]

भीरुक, अस्, आ, अम्, fearful, timid, timorous,
cowardly; afraid; shy; formidable; (अस्), m. an
owl; a bear [cf. भीलुक]; a kind of sugar-cane,
(also written भीरक); N. of a man; (अम्), n. a
wood, forest.
—भीरुक-जन, अस्, m. one whose
servants are cowards.
भीरुण, अस्, आ, अम्, terrific, &c. See अ-भ्˚.

भीर भीर, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people;
(incorrectly for आभीर.)

भीरुकच्छ भीरुकच्छ, आस्, m. pl., N. of a
people; (probably for भरुकच्छ.)
